description.text: Amber emergency strips glow along the floor.
description.else: The ceiling panels give off their usual flat white light.

description.text: Only the amber emergency strips are lit.
description.else: Every light in the corridor is back on.

north.else: The control room door is sealed. Without main power it will not open.

stores.name: Stores
stores.description: Shelves of sealed crates line the walls, each labelled in the station's cramped stencil. The galley is back to the west.

shaft.name: Maintenance Shaft
shaft.description: A vertical shaft lined with cable trays. Rungs lead up to the spine corridor and down to the reactor bay.

description.text: The new coupling sits snugly in its socket.

suit-room.name: Suit Room
suit-room.description: Pressure suits hang in a rack along one wall, though only one of them has ever passed inspection. The spine corridor is north. The airlock's inner hatch is south.

airlock.name: Airlock
airlock.description: A bare chamber just big enough for two people in suits. The inner hatch leads north, back into the station. The outer hatch leads south, out onto the hull.

dish-mount.name: Dish Mount
description: The relay dish is a great white bowl on a gimballed mount, with a stiff handwheel at its base for manual adjustment.

description.text: It points straight along the shipping lane.
description.else: The strike has knocked it askew, and it points uselessly at empty space.

description: The ladder leads back down to the hull.

bunk.name: bunk
bunk.description: Your bunk, its blanket kicked to the floor when the alarm went off.

locker.name: storage locker
locker.description: A grey locker with your name on a strip of tape.

description.text: Its beam has turned a weak yellow.

photo.name: photograph
photo.description: A creased photograph of a coastline you have not seen for two years.

table.name: table
table.description: A fold-down table, scratched by years of cutlery.

slate.name: data slate
slate.description: A battered data slate showing the maintenance log.

mug.name: mug
mug.description: Your mug. The coffee in it went cold hours ago.

keypad.name: keypad
keypad.description: A ten-key pad beside the stores door. Its display reads LOCKED.

stores-door.name: stores door
stores-door.description: A sliding door, opened by the keypad beside it.

crates.name: crates
crates.description: Food, filters, spare seals. Nothing you need right now, except perhaps one thing.

coupling.name: power coupling
coupling.initial: A replacement power coupling sits in a padded cradle on the lowest shelf.
coupling.description: A fist-sized cylinder with gold contacts at each end.

socket.name: socket
socket.description: A round socket in the junction panel, sized for a power coupling.

panel.name: junction panel
panel.description: The main power junction. A socket sits in the middle, with a breaker lever beside it.

description.text: It is locked in the ON position.
description.else: It is in the OFF position.

burnt-coupling.name: burnt coupling
burnt-coupling.initial: A blackened coupling lies on the deck where the surge blew it out of its socket.

core.name: fusion core
core.description: Still running. The core was never the problem.

console.name: beacon console
description: The beacon console. A large TRANSMIT key sits under a hinged guard.

description.text: The dish alignment readout shows a steady green.
description.else: The dish alignment readout blinks red.

window.name: window
window.description: Cloud bands the size of continents drift past, slow as weather on a map.

suit.name: pressure suit
suit.initial: Your pressure suit hangs on the rack, its seals checked and green.
suit.description: A white pressure suit with a domed helmet and a small air pack. The pack holds enough for a short job outside.

rack.name: rack
rack.description: A rack of suits, all but one tagged for repair.

outer-hatch.name: outer hatch
outer-hatch.description: The airlock's outer hatch. Beyond it there is nothing to breathe.

description.text: Steel rungs drop down the well into the maintenance shaft.
The rungs run up to the spine corridor and down to the reactor bay.
The rungs lead up into the shaft.
A maintenance ladder, its rungs worn bright by boots, links the hull and the dish mount.

planet.name: gas giant
planet.description: It fills half the sky, banded in rust and cream.

dish.name: relay dish
description: A white bowl four metres across.

description.text: It is aimed along the shipping lane.
description.else: It is pointing the wrong way. The handwheel at its base would let you align it.
